mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% annually but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing output, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and economic growth concerns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 2% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 6% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating residential construction activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased economic activity and related sector performance.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by more than 10% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below its 12-month moving average signals easing inflationary pressures, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced expectations of aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL declines by more than 1% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the retail sales index (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating consumer spending, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate revenue and economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by more than 5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the employment-to-population ratio (UNRATE) above 60% signals improving labor market conditions, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 60% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances, the hypothesis is falsified.
